scenarios.name: Dismiss the floating ribbon title menu with Escape

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active and the ribbon is floating
the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title
the menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right
the user opens the floating title menu again
the ribbon returns to the top dock
